        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4), .reveal-scale:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5), .reveal-left:nth-child(5), .reveal-scale:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6), .reveal-left:nth-child(6), .reveal-scale:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        /* Custom stagger for deeply nested elements */
        .stagger-1 { transition-delay: 0.08s !important; }
        .stagger-2 { transition-delay: 0.18s !important; }
        .stagger-3 { transition-delay: 0.28s !important; }
        .stagger-4 { transition-delay: 0.38s !important; }
        .stagger-5 { transition-delay: 0.48s !important; }
        .stagger-6 { transition-delay: 0.58s !important; }
        .stagger-7 { transition-delay: 0.68s !important; }

        /* ===========================================
           COMMON TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.015em;
        }

        h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        p, li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.55;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }

        .mono {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
        }

        .accent-cyan { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .accent-amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .accent-green { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .accent-red { color: var(--accent-red); }

        /* ===========================================
           DIVIDER LINE
           =========================================== */
        .divider {
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            margin: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem) 0;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .title-main {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: min(85vw, 900px);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .title-tagline {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: min(72vw, 700px);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.8rem);
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .title-meta-item {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .title-meta-item span {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .title-accent-bar {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-amber), transparent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM SLIDE — THREE-COLUMN COMPARISON
           =========================================== */
        .problem-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .problem-cols {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .problem-col {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .problem-col-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .badge-traj { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .badge-trial { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .badge-know { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }

        .problem-col h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .problem-col p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .problem-col .example-method {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .flood-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,77,106,0.12), rgba(255,77,106,0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,106,0.3);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .flood-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .flood-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .flood-text strong { color: #ff8095; }

        .contrast-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .contrast-box {
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .contrast-box.bad {
            background: rgba(255,77,106,0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,106,0.2);
        }

        .contrast-box.good {
            background: rgba(0,212,255,0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.2);
        }

        .contrast-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .contrast-box.bad .contrast-label { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .contrast-box.good .contrast-label { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES — FLOW DIAGRAM
           =========================================== */
        .modes-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .flow-diagram {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: 0;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Central decision node */
        .flow-decision {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(80px, 12vw, 130px);
            position: relative;
        }

        .decision-diamond {
            width: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            height: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            transform: rotate(45deg);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            position: relative;
        }

        .decision-text {
            position: absolute;
            transform: rotate(-45deg);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.72rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* Connector arrows */
        .flow-connectors {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-around;
            padding: 0 clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .flow-connector {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .connector-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border-mid), transparent);
        }

        .connector-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* Mode cards */
        .mode-cards {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .mode-card {
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: clamp(60px, 10vh, 100px);
        }

        .mode-card.fast {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.1), rgba(0,212,255,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
        }

        .mode-card.slow {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,176,58,0.1), rgba(255,176,58,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,176,58,0.3);
        }

        .mode-card.know {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,229,160,0.1), rgba(0,229,160,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.3);
        }

        .mode-icon {
            width: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
            height: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-green-dim); }

        .mode-info h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .mode-info p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .mode-token {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-token { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-token { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-token { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: PIPELINE — THREE STAGES
           =========================================== */
        .pipeline-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .pipeline-stages {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .pipeline-stage {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pipeline-stage::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
        }

        .stage-1::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent); }
        .stage-2::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-amber), transparent); }
        .stage-3::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-green), transparent); }

        .stage-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.5vw, 2.2rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            opacity: 0.2;
            line-height: 1;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .stage-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.7rem);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .stage-items {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .stage-items li {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.45;
            padding-left: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .stage-items li::before {
            content: '›';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .pipeline-arrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            padding-top: 30%;
        }

        .inference-note {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .inference-note p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES
           =========================================== */
        .qual-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .qual-examples {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .qual-example {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .qual-task-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            background: var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: inline-block;
            align-self: flex-start;
        }

        .qual-task-title {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .qual-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .qual-agent-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .qual-agent-label.baseline { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .qual-agent-label.knowself { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .qual-step {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
            border-left: 2px solid;
        }

        .qual-step.bad { border-color: var(--accent-red); }
        .qual-step.good { border-color: var(--accent-green); }

        .qual-token {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.56rem, 0.85vw, 0.72rem);
            padding: 1px 5px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .token-reflect { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .token-know { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }
        .token-fail { background: var(--accent-red-dim); color: var(--accent-red); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: RESULTS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .results-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .results-table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .results-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.76rem);
        }

        .results-table th {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            white-space: nowrap;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .results-table th:first-child,
        .results-table th:nth-child(2) { text-align: left; }

        .results-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.55vh, 0.5rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.06);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .results-table td:first-child,
        .results-table td:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .results-table td:first-child { color: var(--text-muted); }
        .results-table td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--text-primary); }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,229,160,0.08), rgba(0,229,160,0.03));
        }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row td {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row td:nth-child(2) {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .results-table tr.section-header td {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .know-pct {
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .know-pct.high { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .know-pct.low { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .best-score { color: var(--accent-green); font-weight: 700; }

        .result-callout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .callout-chip {
            flex: 1;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .callout-chip.green {
            background: rgba(0,229,160,0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.3);
        }

        .callout-chip.amber {
            background: rgba(255,176,58,0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,176,58,0.3);
        }

        .callout-chip p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .callout-chip.green p strong { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-chip.amber p strong { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: EFFICIENCY BAR CHART
           =========================================== */
        .efficiency-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .chart-area {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .chart-panel {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.9vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .chart-panel-title {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .bar-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: grid;

    <section class="slide problem-slide" id="slide-2">
        <div class="orb orb-amber" style="width:35vw;height:35vw;top:-15%;right:5%;opacity:0.35;"></div>

        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="section-label">Problem</div>

            <h2 class="reveal">
                Current Agents Use "Flood Irrigation" —<br>
                <span style="color: var(--accent-red);">Indiscriminate Knowledge Injection</span>
            </h2>

            <div class="divider reveal"></div>

            <!-- Three paradigms -->
            <div class="problem-cols reveal">
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-traj">Paradigm 1</div>
                    <h3>Trajectory Imitation</h3>
                    <p>Blindly copies gold action sequences without adapting to what the agent already knows.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., ReAct</div>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-trial">Paradigm 2</div>
                    <h3>Trial-and-Error Refinement</h3>
                    <p>Always invokes costly reflection regardless of whether a step was already correct.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., Reflexion</div>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-know">Paradigm 3</div>
                    <h3>Knowledge-Augmented</h3>
                    <p>Injects domain knowledge at every step — 100% usage — even when unnecessary.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., KnowAgent, WKM</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="contrast-row reveal">
                <div class="contrast-box bad">
                    <div class="contrast-label">❌ Flood Irrigation</div>

                        Fragile planning  · 
                        High inference cost  · 
                        No situational judgment

                <div class="contrast-box good">
                    <div class="contrast-label">✓ Human Metacognition</div>
                    <p style="font-size: var(--small-size); line-height:1.45;">
                        Assess difficulty first  · 
                        Act directly when confident  · 
                        Reflect when uncertain  · 
                        Seek help only when needed
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>

                KnowSelf Pipeline: Data Construction<br>

            <div class="pipeline-stages reveal-scale">

                    <div class="stage-number">01</div>
                    <div class="stage-title">Self-Awareness Data Construction</div>
                    <ul class="stage-items">
                        <li>Agent self-explores task environments</li>
                        <li>Heuristic criterion classifies each step:<br>match → fast, fix-on-reflect → slow, neither → knowledgeable</li>
                        <li>Special tokens <span class="mono accent-cyan"><ACT></span> / <span class="mono accent-amber"><REF></span> / <span class="mono accent-green"><KNO></span> inserted</li>
                        <li>No expensive human annotation required</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-stage stage-2">
                    <div class="stage-number">02</div>
                    <div class="stage-title">Two-Stage Training</div>
                    <ul class="stage-items">
                        <li><strong>Stage 1 — SFT:</strong> Supervised fine-tuning on labeled trajectories to bootstrap self-awareness patterns</li>
                        <li><strong>Stage 2 — RPO:</strong> Reward-based Policy Optimization refines the agent's ability to generate appropriate situational tokens</li>
                        <li>Lightweight: only heuristic-labeled self-explored data</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-stage stage-3">
                    <div class="stage-number">03</div>
                    <div class="stage-title">Self-Aware Inference</div>
                    <ul class="stage-items">
                        <li>Agent generates situational tokens at each step</li>
                        <li><span class="mono accent-cyan"><ACT></span> → direct action</li>
                        <li><span class="mono accent-amber"><REF></span> → trigger reflection loop</li>
                        <li><span class="mono accent-green"><KNO></span> → query external knowledge base</li>
                        <li>Knowledge retrieved <em>only on demand</em> — ~15–26% of steps</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

            </div>

                </p>

         JAVASCRIPT: PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
         Keyboard nav, touch/swipe, progress bar, nav dots,

    <script>
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.setupNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
            this.updateProgress(0);
        }

        /* === NAV DOTS === */
        setupNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
            });
        }

        updateNavDots(index) {
            const dots = this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === index));
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        updateProgress(index) {
            const pct = this.totalSlides > 1
                ? (index / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100
                : 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* === INTERSECTION OBSERVER — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations === */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const options = { threshold: 0.5 };
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentIndex = idx;
                            this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, options);

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));

            // First slide visible immediately
            if (this.slides[0]) this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
        }

        /* === NAVIGATE TO SLIDE === */
        goToSlide(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.totalSlides) return;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* === KEYBOARD NAVIGATION === */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* === TOUCH / SWIPE NAVIGATION === */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let touchStartY = 0;
            let touchStartX = 0;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                const threshold = 50;

                if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > threshold) {
                    this.goToSlide(dy > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* === MOUSE WHEEL NAVIGATION === */
        setupWheelNav() {
            let lastWheelTime = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return; // throttle
                lastWheelTime = now;
                this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
            }, { passive: false });
        }
    }

    // Boot the presentation controller
    new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

</body>
</html>

        }

        .slide.visible .reveal,
        .slide.visible .reveal-left,
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: none;
        }

        /* Staggered delays for sequential child reveals */
        .reveal:nth-child(1), .reveal-left:nth-child(1), .reveal-scale:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2), .reveal-left:nth-child(2), .reveal-scale:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3), .reveal-left:nth-child(3), .reveal-scale:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4), .reveal-scale:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5), .reveal-left:nth-child(5), .reveal-scale:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6), .reveal-left:nth-child(6), .reveal-scale:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        /* Custom stagger for deeply nested elements */
        .stagger-1 { transition-delay: 0.08s !important; }
        .stagger-2 { transition-delay: 0.18s !important; }
        .stagger-3 { transition-delay: 0.28s !important; }
        .stagger-4 { transition-delay: 0.38s !important; }
        .stagger-5 { transition-delay: 0.48s !important; }
        .stagger-6 { transition-delay: 0.58s !important; }
        .stagger-7 { transition-delay: 0.68s !important; }

        /* ===========================================
           COMMON TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.015em;
        }

        h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        p, li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.55;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }

        .mono {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
        }

        .accent-cyan { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .accent-amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .accent-green { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .accent-red { color: var(--accent-red); }

        /* ===========================================
           DIVIDER LINE
           =========================================== */
        .divider {
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            margin: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem) 0;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .title-main {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: min(85vw, 900px);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .title-tagline {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: min(72vw, 700px);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.8rem);
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .title-meta-item {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .title-meta-item span {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .title-accent-bar {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-amber), transparent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM SLIDE — THREE-COLUMN COMPARISON
           =========================================== */
        .problem-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .problem-cols {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .problem-col {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .problem-col-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .badge-traj { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .badge-trial { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .badge-know { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }

        .problem-col h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .problem-col p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .problem-col .example-method {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .flood-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,77,106,0.12), rgba(255,77,106,0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,106,0.3);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .flood-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .flood-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .flood-text strong { color: #ff8095; }

        .contrast-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .contrast-box {
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .contrast-box.bad {
            background: rgba(255,77,106,0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,106,0.2);
        }

        .contrast-box.good {
            background: rgba(0,212,255,0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.2);
        }

        .contrast-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .contrast-box.bad .contrast-label { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .contrast-box.good .contrast-label { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES — FLOW DIAGRAM
           =========================================== */
        .modes-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .flow-diagram {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: 0;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Central decision node */
        .flow-decision {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(80px, 12vw, 130px);
            position: relative;
        }

        .decision-diamond {
            width: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            height: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            transform: rotate(45deg);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            position: relative;
        }

        .decision-text {
            position: absolute;
            transform: rotate(-45deg);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.72rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* Connector arrows */
        .flow-connectors {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-around;
            padding: 0 clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .flow-connector {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .connector-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border-mid), transparent);
        }

        .connector-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* Mode cards */
        .mode-cards {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .mode-card {
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: clamp(60px, 10vh, 100px);
        }

        .mode-card.fast {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.1), rgba(0,212,255,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
        }

        .mode-card.slow {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,176,58,0.1), rgba(255,176,58,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,176,58,0.3);
        }

        .mode-card.know {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,229,160,0.1), rgba(0,229,160,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.3);
        }

        .mode-icon {
            width: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
            height: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-green-dim); }

        .mode-info h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .mode-info p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .mode-token {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-token { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-token { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-token { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: PIPELINE — THREE STAGES
           =========================================== */
        .pipeline-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .pipeline-stages {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .pipeline-stage {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pipeline-stage::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
        }

        .stage-1::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent); }
        .stage-2::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-amber), transparent); }
        .stage-3::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-green), transparent); }

        .stage-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.5vw, 2.2rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            opacity: 0.2;
            line-height: 1;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .stage-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.7rem);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .stage-items {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .stage-items li {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.45;
            padding-left: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .stage-items li::before {
            content: '›';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .pipeline-arrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            padding-top: 30%;
        }

        .inference-note {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .inference-note p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES
           =========================================== */
        .qual-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .qual-examples {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .qual-example {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .qual-task-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            background: var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: inline-block;
            align-self: flex-start;
        }

        .qual-task-title {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .qual-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .qual-agent-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .qual-agent-label.baseline { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .qual-agent-label.knowself { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .qual-step {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
            border-left: 2px solid;
        }

        .qual-step.bad { border-color: var(--accent-red); }
        .qual-step.good { border-color: var(--accent-green); }

        .qual-token {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.56rem, 0.85vw, 0.72rem);
            padding: 1px 5px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .token-reflect { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .token-know { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }
        .token-fail { background: var(--accent-red-dim); color: var(--accent-red); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: RESULTS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .results-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .results-table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .results-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.76rem);
        }

        .results-table th {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            white-space: nowrap;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .results-table th:first-child,
        .results-table th:nth-child(2) { text-align: left; }

        .results-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.55vh, 0.5rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.06);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .results-table td:first-child,
        .results-table td:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .results-table td:first-child { color: var(--text-muted); }
        .results-table td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--text-primary); }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,229,160,0.08), rgba(0,229,160,0.03));
        }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row td {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row td:nth-child(2) {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .results-table tr.section-header td {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .know-pct {
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .know-pct.high { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .know-pct.low { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .best-score { color: var(--accent-green); font-weight: 700; }

        .result-callout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .callout-chip {
            flex: 1;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .callout-chip.green {
            background: rgba(0,229,160,0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.3);
        }

        .callout-chip.amber {
            background: rgba(255,176,58,0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,176,58,0.3);
        }

        .callout-chip p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .callout-chip.green p strong { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-chip.amber p strong { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: EFFICIENCY BAR CHART
           =========================================== */
        .efficiency-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .chart-area {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .chart-panel {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;

    <section class="slide problem-slide" id="slide-2">
        <div class="orb orb-amber" style="width:35vw;height:35vw;top:-15%;right:5%;opacity:0.35;"></div>

        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="section-label">Problem</div>

            <h2 class="reveal">
                Current Agents Use "Flood Irrigation" —<br>
                <span style="color: var(--accent-red);">Indiscriminate Knowledge Injection</span>
            </h2>

            <div class="divider reveal"></div>

            <!-- Three paradigms -->
            <div class="problem-cols reveal">
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-traj">Paradigm 1</div>
                    <h3>Trajectory Imitation</h3>
                    <p>Blindly copies gold action sequences without adapting to what the agent already knows.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., ReAct</div>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-trial">Paradigm 2</div>
                    <h3>Trial-and-Error Refinement</h3>
                    <p>Always invokes costly reflection regardless of whether a step was already correct.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., Reflexion</div>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-know">Paradigm 3</div>
                    <h3>Knowledge-Augmented</h3>
                    <p>Injects domain knowledge at every step — 100% usage — even when unnecessary.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., KnowAgent, WKM</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Shared failure + contrast -->
            <div class="contrast-row reveal">
                <div class="contrast-box bad">
                    <div class="contrast-label">❌ Flood Irrigation</div>

                        No situational judgment

                <div class="contrast-box good">
                    <div class="contrast-label">✓ Human Metacognition</div>
                    <p style="font-size: var(--small-size); line-height:1.45;">
                        Assess difficulty first  · 
                        Act directly when confident  · 
                        Reflect when uncertain  · 
                        Seek help only when needed
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>

                KnowSelf Pipeline: Data Construction<br>

            <div class="pipeline-stages reveal-scale">

                    <div class="stage-number">01</div>
                    <div class="stage-title">Self-Awareness Data Construction</div>
                    <ul class="stage-items">
                        <li>Agent self-explores task environments</li>
                        <li>Heuristic criterion classifies each step:<br>match → fast, fix-on-reflect → slow, neither → knowledgeable</li>
                        <li>Special tokens <span class="mono accent-cyan"><ACT></span> / <span class="mono accent-amber"><REF></span> / <span class="mono accent-green"><KNO></span> inserted</li>
                        <li>No expensive human annotation required</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-stage stage-2">
                    <div class="stage-number">02</div>
                    <div class="stage-title">Two-Stage Training</div>
                    <ul class="stage-items">
                        <li><strong>Stage 1 — SFT:</strong> Supervised fine-tuning on labeled trajectories to bootstrap self-awareness patterns</li>
                        <li><strong>Stage 2 — RPO:</strong> Reward-based Policy Optimization refines the agent's ability to generate appropriate situational tokens</li>
                        <li>Lightweight: only heuristic-labeled self-explored data</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-stage stage-3">
                    <div class="stage-number">03</div>
                    <div class="stage-title">Self-Aware Inference</div>
                    <ul class="stage-items">
                        <li>Agent generates situational tokens at each step</li>
                        <li><span class="mono accent-cyan"><ACT></span> → direct action</li>
                        <li><span class="mono accent-amber"><REF></span> → trigger reflection loop</li>
                        <li><span class="mono accent-green"><KNO></span> → query external knowledge base</li>
                        <li>Knowledge retrieved <em>only on demand</em> — ~15–26% of steps</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

            </div>

                </p>

    <script>
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.setupNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
            this.updateProgress(0);
        }

        /* === NAV DOTS === */
        setupNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
            });
        }

        updateNavDots(index) {
            const dots = this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === index));
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        updateProgress(index) {
            const pct = this.totalSlides > 1
                ? (index / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100
                : 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* === INTERSECTION OBSERVER — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations === */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const options = { threshold: 0.5 };
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentIndex = idx;
                            this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, options);

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));

            // First slide visible immediately
            if (this.slides[0]) this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
        }

        /* === NAVIGATE TO SLIDE === */
        goToSlide(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.totalSlides) return;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* === KEYBOARD NAVIGATION === */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* === TOUCH / SWIPE NAVIGATION === */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let touchStartY = 0;
            let touchStartX = 0;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                const threshold = 50;

                if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > threshold) {
                    this.goToSlide(dy > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* === MOUSE WHEEL NAVIGATION === */
        setupWheelNav() {
            let lastWheelTime = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return; // throttle
                lastWheelTime = now;
                this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
            }, { passive: false });
        }
    }

    // Boot the presentation controller
    new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

</body>
</html>
