        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-30px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.93);
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal,
        .slide.visible .reveal-left,
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: none;
        }

        /* Staggered delays for sequential child reveals */
        .reveal:nth-child(1), .reveal-left:nth-child(1), .reveal-scale:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2), .reveal-left:nth-child(2), .reveal-scale:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3), .reveal-left:nth-child(3), .reveal-scale:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4), .reveal-scale:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5), .reveal-left:nth-child(5), .reveal-scale:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6), .reveal-left:nth-child(6), .reveal-scale:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        /* Custom stagger for deeply nested elements */
        .stagger-1 { transition-delay: 0.08s !important; }
        .stagger-2 { transition-delay: 0.18s !important; }
        .stagger-3 { transition-delay: 0.28s !important; }
        .stagger-4 { transition-delay: 0.38s !important; }
        .stagger-5 { transition-delay: 0.48s !important; }
        .stagger-6 { transition-delay: 0.58s !important; }
        .stagger-7 { transition-delay: 0.68s !important; }

        /* ===========================================
           COMMON TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.015em;
        }

        h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        p, li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.55;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }

        .mono {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
        }

        .accent-cyan { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .accent-amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .accent-green { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .accent-red { color: var(--accent-red); }

        /* ===========================================
           DIVIDER LINE
           =========================================== */
        .divider {
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            margin: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem) 0;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .title-main {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: min(85vw, 900px);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .title-tagline {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: min(72vw, 700px);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.8rem);
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .title-meta-item {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .title-meta-item span {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .title-accent-bar {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-amber), transparent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM SLIDE — THREE-COLUMN COMPARISON
           =========================================== */
        .problem-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .problem-cols {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .problem-col {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .problem-col-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .badge-traj { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .badge-trial { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .badge-know { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }

        .problem-col h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .problem-col p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .problem-col .example-method {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .flood-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,77,106,0.12), rgba(255,77,106,0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,106,0.3);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .flood-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .flood-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .flood-text strong { color: #ff8095; }

        .contrast-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .contrast-box {
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .contrast-box.bad {
            background: rgba(255,77,106,0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,106,0.2);
        }

        .contrast-box.good {
            background: rgba(0,212,255,0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.2);
        }

        .contrast-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .contrast-box.bad .contrast-label { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .contrast-box.good .contrast-label { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES — FLOW DIAGRAM
           =========================================== */
        .modes-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .flow-diagram {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: 0;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Central decision node */
        .flow-decision {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(80px, 12vw, 130px);
            position: relative;
        }

        .decision-diamond {
            width: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            height: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            transform: rotate(45deg);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            position: relative;
        }

        .decision-text {
            position: absolute;
            transform: rotate(-45deg);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.72rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* Connector arrows */
        .flow-connectors {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-around;
            padding: 0 clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .flow-connector {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .connector-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border-mid), transparent);
        }

        .connector-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* Mode cards */
        .mode-cards {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .mode-card {
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: clamp(60px, 10vh, 100px);
        }

        .mode-card.fast {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.1), rgba(0,212,255,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
        }

        .mode-card.slow {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,176,58,0.1), rgba(255,176,58,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,176,58,0.3);
        }

        .mode-card.know {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,229,160,0.1), rgba(0,229,160,0.04));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.3);
        }

        .mode-icon {
            width: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
            height: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-icon { background: var(--accent-green-dim); }

        .mode-info h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-info h3 { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .mode-info p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .mode-token {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .mode-token { background: var(--accent-cyan-dim); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .mode-card.slow .mode-token { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .mode-card.know .mode-token { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: PIPELINE — THREE STAGES
           =========================================== */
        .pipeline-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .pipeline-stages {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .pipeline-stage {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pipeline-stage::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
        }

        .stage-1::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent); }
        .stage-2::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-amber), transparent); }
        .stage-3::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-green), transparent); }

        .stage-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.5vw, 2.2rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            opacity: 0.2;
            line-height: 1;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-number { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .stage-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.7rem);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .stage-items {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .stage-items li {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.45;
            padding-left: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .stage-items li::before {
            content: '›';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .stage-1 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .stage-2 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stage-3 .stage-items li::before { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .pipeline-arrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            padding-top: 30%;
        }

        .inference-note {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .inference-note p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES
           =========================================== */
        .qual-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .qual-examples {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .qual-example {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .qual-task-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            background: var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: inline-block;
            align-self: flex-start;
        }

        .qual-task-title {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .qual-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .qual-agent-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .qual-agent-label.baseline { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .qual-agent-label.knowself { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .qual-step {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
            border-left: 2px solid;
        }

        .qual-step.bad { border-color: var(--accent-red); }
        .qual-step.good { border-color: var(--accent-green); }

        .qual-token {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.56rem, 0.85vw, 0.72rem);
            padding: 1px 5px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .token-reflect { background: var(--accent-amber-dim); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .token-know { background: var(--accent-green-dim); color: var(--accent-green); }
        .token-fail { background: var(--accent-red-dim); color: var(--accent-red); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: RESULTS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .results-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .results-table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .results-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.76rem);
        }

        .results-table th {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            white-space: nowrap;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .results-table th:first-child,
        .results-table th:nth-child(2) { text-align: left; }

        .results-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.55vh, 0.5rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.06);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .results-table td:first-child,
        .results-table td:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .results-table td:first-child { color: var(--text-muted); }
        .results-table td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--text-primary); }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,229,160,0.08), rgba(0,229,160,0.03));
        }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row td {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .results-table tr.knowself-row td:nth-child(2) {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .results-table tr.section-header td {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .know-pct {
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .know-pct.high { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .know-pct.low { color: var(--accent-green); }

        .best-score { color: var(--accent-green); font-weight: 700; }

        .result-callout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .callout-chip {
            flex: 1;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .callout-chip.green {
            background: rgba(0,229,160,0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.3);
        }

        .callout-chip.amber {
            background: rgba(255,176,58,0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,176,58,0.3);
        }

        .callout-chip p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .callout-chip.green p strong { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-chip.amber p strong { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="section-label">Problem</div>

            <h2 class="reveal">
                Current Agents Use "Flood Irrigation" —<br>
                <span style="color: var(--accent-red);">Indiscriminate Knowledge Injection</span>
            </h2>

            <div class="divider reveal"></div>

            <!-- Three paradigms -->
            <div class="problem-cols reveal">
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-traj">Paradigm 1</div>
                    <h3>Trajectory Imitation</h3>
                    <p>Blindly copies gold action sequences without adapting to what the agent already knows.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., ReAct</div>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-trial">Paradigm 2</div>
                    <h3>Trial-and-Error Refinement</h3>
                    <p>Always invokes costly reflection regardless of whether a step was already correct.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., Reflexion</div>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-col">
                    <div class="problem-col-badge badge-know">Paradigm 3</div>
                    <h3>Knowledge-Augmented</h3>
                    <p>Injects domain knowledge at every step — 100% usage — even when unnecessary.</p>
                    <div class="example-method">e.g., KnowAgent, WKM</div>
                </div>
            </div>

                        No situational judgment

                        Act directly when confident  · 
                        Reflect when uncertain  · 
                        Seek help only when needed
                    </p>
                </div>

                KnowSelf Pipeline: Data Construction<br>

                        <li>No expensive human annotation required</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                        <li><strong>Stage 2 — RPO:</strong> Reward-based Policy Optimization refines the agent's ability to generate appropriate situational tokens</li>
                        <li>Lightweight: only heuristic-labeled self-explored data</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-stage stage-3">
                    <div class="stage-number">03</div>

                        <li><span class="mono accent-green"><KNO></span> → query external knowledge base</li>
                        <li>Knowledge retrieved <em>only on demand</em> — ~15–26% of steps</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

         JAVASCRIPT: PRESENTATION CONTROLLER

    <script>
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.setupNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
            this.updateProgress(0);
        }

        /* === NAV DOTS === */
        setupNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
            });
        }

        updateNavDots(index) {
            const dots = this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === index));
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        updateProgress(index) {
            const pct = this.totalSlides > 1
                ? (index / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100
                : 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* === INTERSECTION OBSERVER — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations === */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const options = { threshold: 0.5 };
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentIndex = idx;
                            this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, options);

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));

            // First slide visible immediately
            if (this.slides[0]) this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
        }

        /* === NAVIGATE TO SLIDE === */
        goToSlide(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.totalSlides) return;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* === KEYBOARD NAVIGATION === */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* === TOUCH / SWIPE NAVIGATION === */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let touchStartY = 0;
            let touchStartX = 0;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                const threshold = 50;

                if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > threshold) {
                    this.goToSlide(dy > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* === MOUSE WHEEL NAVIGATION === */
        setupWheelNav() {
            let lastWheelTime = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return; // throttle
                lastWheelTime = now;
                this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
            }, { passive: false });
        }
    }

    // Boot the presentation controller
    new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

</body>

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Convert a single-file HTML presentation into a PPTX deck.
3	
4	Strategy: use Playwright to simulate keyboard navigation (ArrowRight) through
5	the presentation, taking a full-viewport screenshot of each slide, then
6	assemble the images into a 16:9 PPTX via python-pptx.
7	
8	A local HTTP server is started so Google Fonts and relative asset paths load
9	correctly (file:// protocol blocks cross-origin font requests).
10	
11	Usage:
12	    python html_to_pptx.py <input.html> <output.pptx> [--width 1920] [--height 1080]
13	"""
14	
15	import argparse
16	import os
17	import http.server
18	import subprocess
19	import sys
20	import tempfile
21	import threading
22	from pathlib import Path
23	
24	from PIL import Image
25	from pptx import Presentation
26	from pptx.util import Emu
27	
28	
29	# CSS selectors to count slides, tried in order
30	SLIDE_SELECTORS = [".slide", "[data-slide]", "section", "div > section"]
31	
32	
33	def _make_screenshot_script(url: str, out_dir: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
34	    """Return a Node.js script that navigates and screenshots each slide."""
35	    selectors_js = ", ".join(f'"{s}"' for s in SLIDE_SELECTORS)
36	    return f"""\
37	const {{ chromium }} = require('playwright');
38	
39	(async () => {{
40	    const browser = await chromium.launch({{ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH || undefined }});
41	    const page = await browser.newPage();
42	    await page.setViewportSize({{ width: {width}, height: {height} }});
43	    await page.goto('{url}', {{ waitUntil: 'networkidle' }});
44	
45	    // --- Count slides using DOM selectors ---
46	    const selectors = [{selectors_js}];
47	    let slideCount = 0;
48	    for (const sel of selectors) {{
49	        slideCount = await page.$$eval(sel, els => els.length);
50	        if (slideCount > 0) break;
51	    }}
52	
53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---
65	    // We track visual changes to detect when navigation has no more effect
66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).
67	    let prevPath = `{out_dir}/slide_001.png`;
68	    let captured = 1;
69	
70	    for (let i = 2; i <= slideCount; i++) {{
71	        await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
72	        // Wait for transition animation to complete
73	        await page.waitForTimeout(600);
74	
75	        const idx = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
76	        const path = `{out_dir}/slide_${{idx}}.png`;
77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});
78	        captured++;
79	    }}
80	
81	    console.log(JSON.stringify({{ captured }}));
82	    await browser.close();
83	}})();
84	"""
85	
86	
87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique
122	
123	
124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port
132	
133	
134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()
162	
163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs

169	def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()

129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port
132	
133	
134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()
162	
163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs
167	
168	
169	def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175	
176	    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout
177	
178	    for img_path in slide_images:
179	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
180	        slide.shapes.add_picture(
181	            str(img_path),
182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,
185	            height=prs.slide_height,
186	        )
187	
188	    prs.save(str(output_path))
189	
190	
191	def main():
192	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert HTML presentation to PPTX via screenshots")
193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198	
199	    html_path = Path(args.input_html).resolve()
200	    output_path = Path(args.output_pptx).resolve()
201	
202	    if not html_path.exists():
203	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input HTML not found: {html_path}")
204	
205	    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="slides_") as tmp:
206	        tmp_dir = Path(tmp)
207	        print(f"Capturing slides from {html_path} ...")
208	        images = screenshot_slides(html_path, tmp_dir, args.width, args.height)
209	        print(f"Captured {len(images)} unique slide(s), assembling PPTX ...")
210	        assemble_pptx(images, output_path)
211	        print(f"Done → {output_path}")
212	
213	
214	if __name__ == "__main__":
215	    main()

The script counts 8 slides from the DOM but deduplication trimmed to 6. I need to increase wait time and ensure each slide looks distinct. Let me also check what happened — the issue might be that some slides deduplicated due to the background grid pattern.

The real problem: the script captured 8 (correct), but the deduplication algorithm incorrectly considered some adjacent slides as duplicates because they share very similar pixel values at the sample points. I'll increase the wait time and check timing by running with debug.
